name: updraft/prefs@1
description: The personal preferences of the user, kept in this browser, provided by the app on every page. The ion token and API keys are not part of it.

units.description: The display units. The same frozen object until they change.

setUnits.description: Sets the display units. Throws `Invalid units.` when a field is not one of its allowed values.

setAltRef.description: Sets the altitude reference. Throws `Invalid altitude reference.` for any other value than `msl` or `agl`.

league.description: Id of the active XC scoring league. `XContest` when the chosen one was removed.

setLeague.description: Switches the XC league for the whole app. An unknown id throws `Unknown league "x".`.

thermalColumns.description: Whether the thermal columns are drawn in the 3D view.

thermalLabels.description: Whether the thermal labels are drawn in the 3D view.

setThermals.description: Shows or hides the thermal columns and labels. A value that is left out stays as it is. Throws `Thermal switches must be true or false.` for a value that is not a boolean.

units.description: The user or a plugin changed the display units.

thermals.description: The thermal columns or labels switched on or off.

Units.description: The four display units. Values from the studio are always SI, convert them for display.

distance.description: Distances: kilometres, miles or nautical miles.

vario.description: Climb and sink rates: m/s, feet per minute or knots.

AltRef.description: The altitude reference for transition altitudes.
